Admissions
Thank you for your interest in the Duke University Graduate School. Our aim is to attract a vibrant and inclusive student population with a rich array of unique life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe that embracing this framework enriches our academic community and fosters collaboration that enables our graduates to contribute meaningfully to a global society. If you are trying to decide whether Duke is the right place for you, please take some time to review the information on our website. When you are ready to apply, we will guide you through the application process.
The 2026 application to the Duke University Graduate School is now available.

Nondiscrimination Statement
Duke is committed to encouraging and sustaining a learning and work community that is free from prohibited discrimination and harassment. Duke does not discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), sexual orientation, or military status, in the administration of its educational policies, admission policies, financial aid, employment, or any other institution program or activity.
